title: Pocketwire Rewards High-Volume Redeemer Courtesy Schedule
content:
For Pocketwire Rewards members who redeemed at least 100000 points over the last twelve months, the courtesy credit for a late redemption takes a volume-based or blended form.

## Rule

When the courtesy redemption volume is at least 400000 points, the courtesy amount is that volume multiplied by 0.02, rounded down to whole points, in place of the courtesy tier amount; when it is at least 100000 but below 400000 points, the courtesy amount is the courtesy tier amount plus the volume above 100000 points multiplied by 0.01, the added part rounded down to whole points. When the volume is below 100000 points, no such adjustment applies.

## Definitions

- The courtesy redemption volume is the points of all redemption entries, of any kind, dated within the last twelve months.
- The courtesy tier amount is the courtesy points amount of the tier held on the credit date.
- A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Volume bands

| Courtesy redemption volume | Courtesy amount |
|---|---|
| 400000 points or more | the volume multiplied by 0.02, rounded down, in place of the courtesy tier amount |
| 100000 points or more, below 400000 | the courtesy tier amount plus the volume above 100000 multiplied by 0.01, the added part rounded down |
| below 100000 points | no such adjustment |

## Worked examples (hypothetical ledgers)

- Redemptions of 452700 points in the window: 452700 multiplied by 0.02 is 9054 points.
- Redemptions of 187450 points and a courtesy tier amount of 1500: the volume above 100000 is 87450; multiplied by 0.01 it is 874.5, rounded down to 874. The courtesy amount is 1500 plus 874, which is 2374 points.
- A volume of exactly 400000 points gives 8000 points; exactly 100000 points gives the courtesy tier amount with an added part of 0.
- Cash, gift card and charity redemptions all count toward the volume.
